the tempo of a motion picture is a useful high-level semantics construct in its own, as well as a component of other constructs such as rhythm, mood and tone.

tempo can be computed in a computationally feasible way from the attributes of motion, shot length and their interplay, and that it can be used for extracting high-level semantics of motion pictures, such as the story sections and events that they portray.

the development of a novel computational approach to the analysis of motion picture stories and the extraction of their high-level semantics.
the extraction of high-level semantic constructs from motion pictures and with their use in automated content indexing and retrieval.
the development of a computational model for the extraction of expressive elements and high-level semantics from motion pictures.
